title: Writing Semi-Formal Emails
summary: Apologizing politely, justifying, thanking, and asking follow-up questions in email form.
whyItMatters: Semi-formal email is the normal bridge between casual personal writing and highly formal institutional correspondence.

mentalModel.title: Purpose first, context second
mentalModel.content: State why you are writing before giving the minimum background needed.

mentalModel.title: Every problem needs a requested next step
mentalModel.content: After explanation or apology, ask a specific question or propose a solution.

ruleBlocks.title: Use an informative subject and appropriate greeting
ruleBlocks.content: Choose a subject that identifies the course or request and address the recipient consistently.

ruleBlocks.title: State the purpose in the first paragraph
ruleBlocks.content: Use 'Ich schreibe Ihnen, weil ...' or 'Ich möchte mich erkundigen, ob ...'.

ruleBlocks.title: Apologize and explain proportionally
ruleBlocks.content: Acknowledge the issue, give a concise reason, and avoid unnecessary personal detail.

ruleBlocks.title: Ask clearly and close politely
ruleBlocks.content: State the requested response or action, thank the reader, and use a matching closing.

tables.title: Conversation Toolkit
rows: Könnten Sie mir bitte mitteilen, ob ...?
Vielen Dank im Voraus für Ihre Hilfe.

sentenceStructure: Use short paragraphs with one function each.
Place identifying details where the reader needs them.
Proofread names, dates, attachments, and questions.

comparisons.summary: Academic situations provide authentic recipients, deadlines, and requests.
Genitive phrases support concise formal reasons and institutional relationships.

examples.de: Bitte entschuldigen Sie, dass ich die Hausarbeit wegen eines technischen Problems verspätet einreiche.
examples.en: Please excuse my submitting the paper late because of a technical problem.

examples.de: Könnten Sie mir bitte mitteilen, ob ich noch am Seminar teilnehmen kann?
examples.en: Could you please tell me whether I can still participate in the seminar?

examples.de: Im Anhang finden Sie den fehlenden Sprachnachweis.
examples.en: Attached you will find the missing language certificate.

examples.de: Vielen Dank für Ihre schnelle Antwort und Ihre Unterstützung.
examples.en: Thank you for your quick reply and support.

examples.de: Für Rückfragen bin ich jederzeit erreichbar. Mit freundlichen Grüßen
examples.en: I am available at any time for further questions. Kind regards

commonMistakes.reason: A specific subject helps routing and response.

commonMistakes.wrong: Hallo! Ich brauche sofort eine Antwort.
commonMistakes.correct: Use a respectful greeting and a clear, proportionate request.

commonMistakes.wrong: Explain the situation without asking anything.
commonMistakes.correct: End with the exact information or action needed.
commonMistakes.reason: The reader must know how to respond.

tips: Draft the request sentence before the explanation.
Keep one email to one main purpose.
Read the message once from the recipient's perspective.
